title: Friends in the Basie band
summary: Joe Newman, Dickie Wells, Illinois Jacquet, Jo Jones and Snooky Young.

story.theme_name: Playing with Count Basie: joining, leading, leaving
story.community_name: Playing with Count Basie: the band, its feel and its people

blocks.x: Who were some of your good friends in the Basie band when you were with them? Did you have anyone you were particularly close to?
Joe Newman. Dickie Wells and I would hang out together. Illinois Jacquet. Jo Jones, the drummer – the Basie Jo Jones, not the Philly Joe Jones.

Those persons come to mind. There was a trumpet player, Snooky Young, [who] was in Basie’s band for a while. We became very good friends through the years and we still are, except I haven’t seen him in quite a long time – since moving from California, as a matter of fact. He was really a good buddy of mine, Snooky was [a] sweetheart of a person, a sweetheart of a musician. Those are the persons that come to mind.
